hero.title: Your staff already know things these students cannot find out
hero.body: List employees as mentors, cover a school talk, or fund a term of them. It meets a CSR objective without a workshop, a lanyard or a report nobody reads, and it is felt by an actual fifteen-year-old.

ways.title: Three ways in
ways.body: None of it needs a budget line to begin. The usual first step is four or five staff who are willing.

items.title: List staff as mentors
items.body: Employees who opt in appear under their industry, available for questions or a school visit. No obligation past what each of them agrees to, and their contact details stay private.

items.title: Cover a talk
items.body: The honorarium for a mentor's time and travel, typically €50 to €150, so a school can bring somebody in without finding the money themselves.

items.title: Fund the thing itself
items.body: Annual sponsorship of €2,000 to €10,000 pays for the coordination that keeps the directory free to the schools that need it. You are credited as a partner. That is the whole arrangement.

cta.title: Worth a conversation?
cta.body: Tell us roughly what you have in mind. A few willing staff, one sponsored talk, or something ongoing. We will work out what fits and we will not send you a deck.
